title: PCBRouteAgent: How Close Are LLM Agents to Becoming PCB Routing Engineers?
title_zh: PCBRouteAgent：智能体距离成为PCB布线工程师还有多远？

paragraphs.en: Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules. Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging. We present PCBRouteAgent , a multimodal PCB routing agent inspired by how human engineers coordinate global strategy with local execution. A Global Routing Planner combines board images and structured electrical and geometric information to specify connection topology, routing order, corridors, and layer transitions. A Detailed Routing Executor realizes these guides through KiCad’s native routing engine and performs bounded local recovery. Unresolved failures are returned as structured feedback, enabling targeted guide revisions while preserving accepted routes. We evaluate PCBRouteAgent on 247 synthetic and real-world boards from four PCBWorld-Bench test splits. It achieves clean-pass rates of 100%, 94.9%, 100%, and 40% on D2, D3-A, D3-B, and D3-C, respectively. On the three real-world subsets, PCBRouteAgent outperforms the best evaluated baseline in clean-pass rate by 13.9, 36, and 10 percentage points, respectively. The project page and code are available at https://chip-ai-agent.github.io/research/pcbrouteagent and https://github.com/chip-ai-agent/PCBRouteAgent , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化印刷电路板（PCB）布线需要在严格的设计规则下，将板级连接决策与几何执行相协调。 尽管近期的智能体能够与原生布线工具交互，但在复杂电路板上实现可靠布线仍然具有挑战性。 我们提出了 PCBRouteAgent，一个受人类工程师如何协调全局策略与局部执行启发的多模态 PCB 布线智能体。 全局布线规划器结合电路板图像以及结构化的电气与几何信息，来指定连接拓扑、布线顺序、走线通道和层间转换。 详细布线执行器通过 KiCad 的原生布线引擎实现这些指引，并执行有界局部恢复。 未解决的失败会以结构化反馈的形式返回，从而在保留已接受布线的同时实现有针对性的指引修订。 我们在来自 PCBWorld-Bench 四个测试划分的 247 块合成与真实电路板上评估 PCBRouteAgent。 它在 D2、D3-A、D3-B 和 D3-C 上分别实现了 100%、94.9%、100% 和 40% 的清洁通过率。 在三个真实世界子集上，PCBRouteAgent 的清洁通过率分别比所评估的最佳基线高出 13.9、36 和 10 个百分点。 项目主页和代码分别可在 https://chip-ai-agent.github.io/research/pcbrouteagent 和 https://github.com/chip-ai-agent/PCBRouteAgent 获取。

paragraphs.en: Printed circuit boards (PCBs) provide mechanical support and electrical interconnections for electronic components. Before a circuit design can be fabricated as a PCB, its schematic connectivity must be translated into a physical board layout. This process includes component placement, which determines the positions and orientations of component footprints, followed by routing, which realizes the required electrical connections. As illustrated in Figure 1 , routing connects the pads belonging to each electrical net 1 1 1 A net is an electrical connectivity group in a PCB design, specifying the component terminals that must be electrically connected according to the circuit schematic. through copper traces and, when necessary, vias that enable transitions between copper layers. A net may contain two or more pads, all of which must form a connected network while remaining electrically isolated from other nets. The resulting routing must satisfy design rules governing clearance, trace width, vias, and board boundaries, as well as signal-specific constraints such as differential-pair requirements [ 1 , 2 ] . Beyond establishing valid connections, routing also seeks to limit wirelength and unnecessary layer transitions while preserving space for other nets. These requirements make PCB routing a coupled physical design problem in which each routing decision affects the connections that remain to be completed.
paragraphs.zh: 印制电路板（PCB）为电子元器件提供机械支撑和电气互连。 在电路设计能够被制造成 PCB 之前，其原理图连接关系必须被转换为实际的板级布局。 这一过程包括元器件布局，即确定元器件封装的位置和朝向，随后进行布线，即实现所需的电气连接。 如图 1 所示，布线通过铜导线以及在必要时通过实现铜层之间转换的过孔，将属于每个电气网络（注 1：网络是 PCB 设计中的一个电气连接分组，指明根据电路原理图必须电气连接的元器件端点）的焊盘连接起来。 一个网络可能包含两个或多个焊盘，所有这些焊盘必须构成一个连通的网络，同时与其他网络保持电气隔离。 最终的布线必须满足关于间距、导线宽度、过孔和板边的设计规则，以及诸如差分对要求等信号特定的约束 [ 1 , 2 ] 。 除了建立有效连接之外，布线还力求在为其他网络保留空间的同时，限制导线长度和不必要的层间转换。 这些要求使 PCB 布线成为一个耦合的物理设计问题，其中每一个布线决策都会影响尚未完成的连接。

paragraphs.en: Routing complex PCBs remains labor-intensive, motivating automatic routers that reduce the need for manual trace construction. Classical rule-based methods use heuristic search [ 3 ] , net ordering, and congestion-aware costs [ 1 ] to construct routes under geometric constraints. Although these methods automate much of the process, complex boards can still require careful tuning and manual intervention [ 2 ] . To reduce this reliance on handcrafted decisions, learning-based approaches have been explored for routing tasks, including global routing [ 4 ] , net ordering [ 5 ] , and PCB fanout [ 6 ] . Their effectiveness, however, depends on how routing decisions are represented and connected to physical execution. As discussed in PCBWorld [ 2 ] , grid-based formulations face rapidly growing decision spaces as routing resolution increases, while approaches that guide an existing autorouter leave much of the physical routing process to that router. These limitations motivate studying agents that interact directly with a design engine and adapt their decisions using execution feedback. PCBWorld [ 2 ] provides such an environment by exposing KiCad’s native routing operations and design-rule feedback to reinforcement-learning policies and tool-using LLM agents. This interaction allows agents to observe the consequences of routing decisions and revise subsequent actions as the board evolves.
paragraphs.zh: 复杂 PCB 的布线仍然耗费大量人力，这推动了自动布线器的发展，以减少人工构建走线的需求。 经典的基于规则的方法使用启发式搜索 [ 3 ] 、网络排序和考虑拥塞的代价 [ 1 ] ，在几何约束下构建布线。 尽管这些方法实现了流程的大部分自动化，但复杂的电路板仍然需要细致的调优和人工干预 [ 2 ] 。 为了减少对手工决策的依赖，基于学习的方法已被探索用于布线任务，包括全局布线 [ 4 ] 、网络排序 [ 5 ] 和 PCB 扇出 [ 6 ] 。 然而，这些方法的有效性取决于布线决策如何被表示并与物理执行相连接。 正如 PCBWorld [ 2 ] 所讨论的，随着布线分辨率的提高，基于网格的公式化方法面临快速增长的决策空间，而引导现有自动布线器的方法则将大部分物理布线过程留给该布线器完成。 这些局限性促使人们研究能够直接与设计引擎交互并利用执行反馈调整决策的智能体。 PCBWorld [ 2 ] 通过向强化学习策略和使用工具的 LLM 智能体开放 KiCad 的原生布线操作和设计规则反馈，提供了这样一个环境。 这种交互使智能体能够观察布线决策的后果，并随着电路板的演进修改后续动作。

paragraphs.en: Despite this progress, reliable agent-based PCB routing remains challenging. The LLM agents evaluated in PCBWorld [ 2 ] still lag behind rule-based routers in completing connections while satisfying design rules, particularly on complex real-world boards. Providing access to native routing operations and execution feedback does not, by itself, ensure effective board-level coordination. An agent must decide which connections to prioritize, allocate limited routing space across competing nets, and determine when a layer transition is necessary. These decisions are coupled: a locally feasible route may block subsequent connections, while a connection that repeatedly fails may require a change in its topology or layer assignment rather than another local attempt. Moreover, as routing proceeds, the agent must distinguish difficulties that can be resolved locally from those requiring a broader strategy revision. These challenges highlight the need for an explicit mechanism that coordinates board-level planning with geometric execution and uses routing failures to revise the plan.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，可靠的基于智能体的 PCB 布线仍然具有挑战性。 在 PCBWorld [ 2 ] 中评估的 LLM 智能体在完成连线的同时满足设计规则方面，仍落后于基于规则的路由器，尤其是在复杂的真实电路板上。 仅仅提供原生布线操作的访问权限和执行反馈，本身并不能确保有效的板级协调。 智能体必须决定优先处理哪些连线，在相互竞争的网络之间分配有限的布线空间，并确定何时需要进行层切换。 这些决策是相互耦合的：一个局部可行的布线可能会阻塞后续的连线，而反复失败的连线可能需要改变其拓扑或层分配，而不是再次进行局部尝试。 此外，随着布线的推进，智能体必须区分可以在局部解决的困难与需要更广泛策略修订的困难。 这些挑战凸显了需要一个显式机制，将板级规划与几何执行相协调，并利用布线失败来修订规划。

paragraphs.en: To address these limitations, we propose PCBRouteAgent , a multimodal PCB routing agent inspired by how human routing engineers coordinate global strategy with local execution. Engineers consider connection priorities, routing regions, and layer usage while constructing individual traces, and revisit these decisions when local obstacles prevent further progress. Following this principle, PCBRouteAgent integrates a Global Routing Planner and a Detailed Routing Executor through a feedback-driven planning–execution loop. The planner combines board images with structured electrical and geometric information to organize connectivity demands into routing guides specifying connection topology, routing order, corridors, and layer transitions. The executor translates these guides into physical traces and vias through KiCad’s native routing engine, using bounded local recovery to handle geometric difficulties. When recovery is insufficient, it returns structured execution evidence to the planner, which generates targeted guide revisions while preserving accepted routes. This design enables board-level guidance to adapt to the physical constraints revealed during execution.

paragraphs.en: PCB routing connects the pads specified by a netlist while respecting the geometry of components, existing copper, board boundaries, and electrical design rules. Classical approaches search for feasible paths and then refine them according to costs such as wirelength, congestion, and the number of vias. In IC routing, TritonRoute [ 9 ] illustrates the global–detailed decomposition: global routing determines coarse topology and layer guidance, while detailed routing realizes traces and vias under geometric design rules. Lee’s maze-routing algorithm [ 3 ] established a systematic way to find connections in a discretized search space; subsequent PCB routers have incorporated constraints that simple shortest-path search cannot capture. For example, Lin et al. [ 1 ] address complicated board constraints and differential pairs within a unified routing algorithm. These methods demonstrate the value of explicit geometric search and rule-aware optimization, but they also make clear that routing quality depends on decisions made across multiple scales: the order in which nets are attempted, the space reserved for future connections, and the local shape of each trace. Learning-based work has targeted different parts of this decision process. Liao et al. [ 4 ] investigate deep reinforcement learning for global routing, while FanoutNet [ 6 ] learns decisions for the specialized PCB fanout problem. GPCB [ 10 ] uses a generative pretrained Transformer to predict routing-related network-flow patterns and then constructs physical routes from those predictions. More recently, world-model reinforcement learning [ 5 ] has been integrated with Freerouting so that learned guidance can be combined with an existing autorouter. These systems differ in what they predict and in how much of the routing procedure is handled by a separate search or routing engine. PCBWorld [ 2 ] provides another setting: it exposes KiCad’s native routing operations to reinforcement-learning policies and tool-using LLM agents, and evaluates the resulting board with engine-based design-rule checks. This interactive setting makes it possible to observe how a routing decision changes the board before choosing the next action. Our work uses that setting to study the agent’s ability to coordinate routing decisions over an evolving board, rather than treating each connection as an isolated path-finding problem.

paragraphs.en: LLM agents have begun to use EDA tools as part of longer design workflows, where a model plans tool calls and uses their feedback to guide later steps. ReAct [ 11 ] interleaves reasoning with environment actions, while Reflexion [ 12 ] uses feedback and reflective memory to improve subsequent attempts without updating model weights. Such workflows require the agent to track design state, choose suitable tools, and recover when a tool reports an error. ChatEDA [ 13 ] connects language-model planning to EDA tool invocation in an RTL-to-GDSII flow, and EDAid [ 14 ] investigates collaboration among multiple agents for electronic design automation. VerilogCoder [ 15 ] focuses on HDL development, using planning and feedback from code-oriented tools, including waveform tracing, to revise generated Verilog. Although these systems address different stages of hardware design, they share a useful pattern: the agent proposes an action, receives evidence from a domain tool, and uses that evidence to decide what to do next. PCB layout presents a different physical interface to this pattern. PCBAgent [ 16 ] combines an RL-based placement agent with an LLM agent for interactive component-placement optimization; placement choices affect routability, but placement alone does not test whether an agent can complete the required copper connections. Recent PCB benchmarks have made such distinctions more visible. PCB-Bench [ 17 ] evaluates LLMs on PCB placement and routing tasks, including the interpretation of board information. OmniRouting [ 18 ] assesses routing reasoning under geometric, design-rule, and electrical constraints, and includes a tool-augmented task. These evaluations help characterize what a model understands or proposes, while an interactive routing environment additionally reveals whether a sequence of actions yields a valid board as the geometry changes. PCBWorld [ 2 ] supplies this engine-grounded interface and evaluates completed boards with native design-rule feedback. PCBRouteAgent therefore studies an LLM agent in the closed loop between planning, tool execution, board-state observation, and validation. The emphasis is on the agent’s ability to maintain global routing objectives while adapting its next decision to the board produced by earlier actions.

paragraphs.en: From the perspective of a PCB routing engineer, routing requires decisions at two spatial scales: coordinating connection priorities, routing regions, and layer usage across the board, and realizing individual traces around pads and obstacles. A locally feasible connection may consume space needed by another net, while a promising board-level strategy may prove geometrically infeasible during execution. This motivates separating global planning from detailed routing and revising the plan when local difficulties arise. A similar separation is used in IC routing flows such as OpenROAD [ 19 ] , where global routing produces guides for detailed routing.

paragraphs.en: We adopt this principle for PCB routing. To address this challenge, the Global Routing Planner first organizes disconnected components within each net into a connection topology and then assigns spatial routing guides to support their physical realization. This information is represented in two complementary forms. The visual modality ℐ = { I layout , I front , I back , I demand } \mathcal{I}=\{I_{\mathrm{layout}},I_{\mathrm{front}},I_{\mathrm{back}},I_{\mathrm{demand}}\} depicts the overall board layout, front- and back-copper states, and outstanding connectivity demands. For each target net n ∈ 𝒩 n\in\mathcal{N} , electrically connected pads form clusters 𝒞 n = { C n , 1 , … , C n , K n } \mathcal{C}_{n}=\{C_{n,1},\ldots,C_{n,K_{n}}\} , whose remaining connections define the routing demands. paragraphs.en: Although the board representation identifies the remaining connectivity demands, it does not specify how disconnected clusters should be connected. For a net containing multiple clusters, numerous connection topologies can satisfy the same electrical requirements, while independently connecting every pair would introduce unnecessary routing. To avoid exhaustively searching this combinatorial space, we formulate connectivity planning as a minimum spanning tree (MST) [ 21 ] problem over the disconnected clusters, yielding a compact initial topology. For each target net n n , we construct a weighted graph G n = ( 𝒞 n , ℰ n , w n ) G_{n}=(\mathcal{C}_{n},\mathcal{E}_{n},w_{n}) , where vertices represent connectivity clusters and edges represent candidate inter-cluster connections. Each candidate edge e ∈ ℰ n e\in\mathcal{E}_{n} is assigned a weight w n ​ ( e ) w_{n}(e) based on the minimum Euclidean distance between pads in the corresponding clusters, with an additional penalty for incompatible pad layers. The resulting MST T n = ( 𝒞 n , ℰ n ∗ ) T_{n}=(\mathcal{C}_{n},\mathcal{E}_{n}^{*}) specifies K n − 1 K_{n}-1 connection tasks spanning the K n K_{n} clusters. It minimizes the estimated total cost under this heuristic, while leaving the physical realization of these connections to subsequent routing stages.

paragraphs.en: Beyond determining the connection topology within each net, the planner must also coordinate routing across multiple nets that share limited board space. We therefore initialize the routing order using the total estimated connection length of each net’s spanning tree, prioritizing shorter nets first. paragraphs.en: While the connection topology specifies which clusters should be connected, it does not determine how these connections should traverse the physical board. Directly prescribing exact trace geometries at the global planning stage would require resolving fine-grained obstacles and design-rule constraints before routing execution. Instead, we separate high-level spatial guidance from low-level geometric realization, allowing the Global Routing Planner to guide routing decisions while preserving flexibility for local obstacle avoidance. Specifically, for each connection edge e e , we use the endpoint pads selected during topology construction to initialize ordered corridor guidance 𝒬 e = ( 𝒬 e , 1 , … , 𝒬 e , m e ) \mathcal{Q}_{e}=(\mathcal{Q}_{e,1},\ldots,\mathcal{Q}_{e,m_{e}}) , where m e m_{e} is the number of corridor stages for connection e e . When the endpoints share a copper layer, we construct a single corridor 𝒬 e , 1 \mathcal{Q}_{e,1} from their axis-aligned bounding box, expanded by a margin δ \delta in each direction. The resulting rectangle provides spatial guidance while leaving the exact trace geometry to the Detailed Routing Executor.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然连接拓扑规定了哪些集群应当被连接，但它并不决定这些连接应如何穿越物理电路板。 在全局规划阶段直接规定精确的走线几何形状，将需要在布线执行之前就解决细粒度的障碍物和设计规则约束。 相反，我们将高层空间引导与低层几何实现相分离，让全局布线规划器（Global Routing Planner）引导布线决策，同时为局部避障保留灵活性。 具体而言，对于每条连接边 e e ，我们使用拓扑构建阶段选定的端点焊盘来初始化有序走廊引导 𝒬 e = ( 𝒬 e , 1 , … , 𝒬 e , m e ) \mathcal{Q}_{e}=(\mathcal{Q}_{e,1},\ldots,\mathcal{Q}_{e,m_{e}}) ，其中 m e m_{e} 是连接 e e 的走廊阶段数量。 当两个端点共享同一铜层时，我们从它们的轴对齐包围盒构建单一走廊 𝒬 e , 1 \mathcal{Q}_{e,1} ，并在每个方向上扩展一个边距 δ \delta 。 得到的矩形提供空间引导，同时将精确的走线几何形状留给详细布线执行器（Detailed Routing Executor）。

To address this gap, the Global Routing Planner revises its routing strategy using evidence obtained from detailed execution.

paragraphs.en: The planner outputs a structured guide patch specifying targeted changes to connection endpoints, routing corridors, via-transition regions, or routing order. The patch updates the affected portions of the current guide while preserving previously accepted routes outside that scope. Before execution resumes, the patch is checked for consistency with the current snapshot and guide revision, as well as valid references to clusters, corridors, and copper layers. If validation fails, the same planner may be asked to correct its response using the previous output and validation errors; the correction prompt template is listed in Appendix B.2 . The validated patch is merged into the guide, and affected connection tasks are recompiled for the Detailed Routing Executor. This planning–execution loop continues until the target connections are completed, no further tasks can be scheduled, or the execution or replanning budget is exhausted.

paragraphs.en: The Detailed Routing Executor takes the routing guide produced by the Global Routing Planner and compiles its planned connection edges into executable tasks. For each connection edge e e , a task specifies the source and target connectivity clusters, candidate pad anchors, ordered layer-specific corridors 𝒬 e \mathcal{Q}_{e} , and optional via-transition regions 𝒱 e \mathcal{V}_{e} . The executor uses this guidance together with the design rules ℛ \mathcal{R} to select routing targets and invoke native routing operations. These tasks are scheduled according to the routing priorities established by the Global Routing Planner, with connections within each net following their predefined task order. For each task, the executor selects a source anchor from the designated cluster that lies within the initial routing corridor and supports its assigned copper layer, prioritizing candidates closer to the next routing target. A compatible target anchor is identified from the destination cluster based on the final routing stage.
paragraphs.zh: 详细布线执行器接收全局布线规划器生成的布线引导，并将其规划出的连接边编译为可执行任务。 对于每条连接边 e，一个任务会指定源连接簇与目标连接簇、候选焊盘锚点、按层排序的走廊 𝒬_e，以及可选的过孔转换区域 𝒱_e。 执行器利用该引导信息以及设计规则 ℛ 来选择布线目标并调用原生布线操作。 这些任务按照全局布线规划器确定的布线优先级进行调度，同一网络内的连接遵循其预定义的任务顺序。 对于每个任务，执行器从指定簇中选择一个位于初始布线走廊内且支持其指定铜层的源锚点，并优先选择更靠近下一个布线目标的候选者。 兼容的目标锚点则根据最终布线阶段从目标簇中确定。

paragraphs.en: Instead of prescribing a fixed trace path, the executor progressively advances through the planned routing stages by selecting intermediate waypoints. For consecutive corridors 𝒬 e , j \mathcal{Q}_{e,j} and 𝒬 e , j + 1 \mathcal{Q}_{e,j+1} on the same layer, it identifies their overlapping region and generates candidate waypoints at the region center and surrounding positions, accounting for trace width and clearance requirements. These candidates are attempted sequentially through PNS, which constructs the physical trace between the current routing position and the selected target while handling local geometric constraints. Upon a successful attempt, the executor updates its routing position and proceeds to the next stage.
paragraphs.zh: 执行器不是预先规定一条固定的走线路径，而是通过选择中间途经点，逐步推进经过规划的布线阶段。 对于同一层上的相邻走廊 𝒬 e , j \mathcal{Q}_{e,j} 和 𝒬 e , j + 1 \mathcal{Q}_{e,j+1}，智能体识别它们的重叠区域，并在该区域中心及周围位置生成候选途经点，同时考虑走线宽度和间距要求。 这些候选点通过 PNS 依次尝试，PNS 在处理局部几何约束的同时，构建当前布线位置与所选目标之间的物理走线。 一次尝试成功后，执行器更新其布线位置并进入下一个阶段。

paragraphs.en: When a connection requires a layer transition, the executor instead generates candidate via locations within the designated transition region 𝒱 e \mathcal{V}_{e} , accounting for via dimensions and clearance requirements. It then attempts to establish the transition before continuing on the next copper layer. After traversing the planned routing stages, the executor attempts to reach the target cluster and verifies whether the source and target clusters have become electrically connected. This connectivity-based verification ensures that task completion reflects an established physical connection rather than merely a successful intermediate routing operation.
paragraphs.zh: 当连接需要层间过渡时，执行器改为在指定的过渡区域 𝒱 e \mathcal{V}_{e} 内生成候选过孔位置，并考虑过孔尺寸与间隙要求。 随后它尝试建立该过渡，然后继续在下一个铜层上布线。 在 traversing 完规划的布线阶段后，执行器尝试到达目标簇，并验证源簇与目标簇是否已实现电气连接。 这种基于连通性的验证确保任务完成反映的是已建立的物理连接，而不仅仅是某次成功的中间布线操作。

sents.zh: 当连接需要层间过渡时，执行器改为在指定的过渡区域 𝒱 e \mathcal{V}_{e} 内生成候选过孔位置，并考虑过孔尺寸与间隙要求。

sents.zh: 随后它尝试建立该过渡，然后继续在下一个铜层上布线。

paragraphs.en: Although PNS can handle many local geometric constraints, routing attempts may still fail when obstacles block the selected path, restrict access to intermediate waypoints, or prevent a layer transition. Immediately triggering global replanning for every failure would introduce unnecessary overhead, particularly when alternative local paths remain available. We therefore employ a bounded recovery strategy that progressively explores alternative routing options before escalating unresolved failures to the Global Routing Planner.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 PNS 能够处理许多局部几何约束，但当障碍物阻挡所选路径、限制对中间路径点的访问或阻止层间转换时，路由尝试仍可能失败。 每次失败都立即触发全局重规划会引入不必要的开销，尤其是在仍有可用的局部替代路径时。 因此，我们采用一种有界恢复策略，在将未解决的失败上报给全局路由规划器之前，逐步探索替代路由选项。

sents.en: Although PNS can handle many local geometric constraints, routing attempts may still fail when obstacles block the selected path, restrict access to intermediate waypoints, or prevent a layer transition.
sents.zh: 尽管 PNS 能够处理许多局部几何约束，但当障碍物阻挡所选路径、限制对中间路径点的访问或阻止层间转换时，路由尝试仍可能失败。

sents.en: Immediately triggering global replanning for every failure would introduce unnecessary overhead, particularly when alternative local paths remain available.
sents.zh: 每次失败都立即触发全局重规划会引入不必要的开销，尤其是在仍有可用的局部替代路径时。

sents.en: We therefore employ a bounded recovery strategy that progressively explores alternative routing options before escalating unresolved failures to the Global Routing Planner.
sents.zh: 因此，我们采用一种有界恢复策略，在将未解决的失败上报给全局路由规划器之前，逐步探索替代路由选项。

paragraphs.en: When a routing attempt fails, the executor first explores local geometric alternatives through PNS, using walkaround to navigate obstacles and shove to adjust obstructing traces when necessary. If the current target remains unreachable, it attempts alternative waypoints within the designated routing region. For more challenging same-layer obstacles, a grid-based A* search [ 22 ] identifies potential detours, which are subsequently executed through PNS. The executor can further backtrack to earlier routing stages or switch to alternative source anchors within the same connectivity cluster. These operations expand the local search space while preserving the connection topology and layer-transition regions established by the Global Routing Planner. To avoid excessive exploration, recovery attempts are bounded by retry and execution budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 当布线尝试失败时，执行器首先通过 PNS 探索局部几何替代方案，必要时使用绕行走导航避开障碍物，并使用推挤来调整阻挡的走线。 如果当前目标仍然不可达，它会尝试指定布线区域内的其他路径点。 对于更具挑战性的同层障碍物，基于网格的 A* 搜索 [ 22 ] 会识别潜在的绕行路径，随后通过 PNS 执行这些路径。 执行器还可以进一步回溯到较早的布线阶段，或切换到同一连通簇内的其他源锚点。 这些操作在保留全局布线规划器所建立的连接拓扑和层间过渡区域的同时，扩展了局部搜索空间。 为避免过度探索，恢复尝试受到重试预算和执行预算的限制。

paragraphs.en: When local recovery is exhausted or a planned layer transition cannot be completed, the executor generates a structured feedback packet ℱ e \mathcal{F}_{e} for the current connection e e , describing the attempted routing operations, last reached position, potential blocking obstacles, affected routing regions, and deviations from the original guidance. Failed tasks are rolled back to a consistent checkpoint, while previously accepted connections outside the affected scope are preserved. Rather than reporting failure as a binary outcome, the executor provides actionable evidence that helps the Global Routing Planner identify which higher-level decisions may require revision. This separation allows local geometric difficulties to be addressed through efficient recovery operations, while reserving global replanning for failures that cannot be resolved within the existing routing strategy. The resulting feedback is passed to the Global Routing Planner for the feedback-driven replanning described in Section 3.2.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 当局部恢复手段耗尽或无法完成计划中的层间切换时，执行器会为当前连接 e 生成结构化反馈包 ℱ e \mathcal{F}_{e}，其中描述已尝试的布线操作、最后到达的位置、潜在的阻塞障碍、受影响的布线区域，以及与原始引导的偏差。 失败的任务会回滚到一致的检查点，而受影响范围之外先前已被接受的连接则予以保留。 执行器不是将失败作为二元结果进行报告，而是提供可操作的证据，帮助全局布线规划器识别哪些更高层级的决策可能需要修订。 这种分离使得局部几何困难可以通过高效的恢复操作来解决，同时将全局重规划保留给无法在现有布线策略内解决的失败情况。 由此产生的反馈会被传递给全局布线规划器，用于第 3.2.4 节所述的反馈驱动重规划。

paragraphs.en: The execution controller terminates the routing loop when all target connections are established, no further tasks or permitted recovery attempts remain, or the execution budget is exhausted. Connections that exhaust their replanning allowance are recorded as unresolved while other tasks may continue. A checkpoint or rollback failure also triggers early termination. On termination, the system saves the last consistent board state and reports completed and unresolved connections. Routing success is determined by the official evaluator applied to the saved board.
paragraphs.zh: 执行控制器在所有目标连线均已建立、没有剩余任务或许可的恢复尝试、或执行预算耗尽时终止路由循环。 耗尽其重新规划额度的连线会被记录为未解决，而其他任务可以继续进行。 检查点或回滚失败也会触发提前终止。 终止时，系统保存最后一个一致的棋盘状态，并报告已完成和未解决的连线。 路由成功与否由应用于所保存棋盘的官方评估器来判定。

paragraphs.en: We follow the agent-comparison setting of PCBWorld-Bench [ 2 ] . Each instance is a board in KiCad’s [ 20 ] native .kicad_pcb format, with reference routes removed; component placement, netlist, and design rules remain fixed. The task is to complete the connections on that board, and the final board is evaluated by KiCad rather than by the agent’s own estimate of success. We use the same three test sets as the PCBWorld main comparison: 128 synthetic, two-layer gridless boards from D2-test; 99 small open-source boards from D3-A; and 10 medium open-source boards from D3-B. We additionally include the 10 large open-source boards in PCBWorld’s [ 2 ] fixed D3-C evaluation subset. PCBWorld excludes one of the 100 D3-A boards because its engine interface cannot load it. The D3-B and D3-C test subsets contain two-layer boards selected across each split’s pad-count range; D3-C contains boards with more than 100 pads. D2 tests routing on boards drawn from the synthetic distribution, while all three D3 splits test transfer to real designs with their original design-rule settings. The Reference rows in Tables 2 – 4 evaluate the original routed designs retained in PCBWorld’s open-source board corpus [ 2 ] . Each routing input is obtained by removing the target routing while preserving component placement, the netlist, and design rules; the Reference is the retained design before this removal, scored using the same official engine-based evaluator. D3-A and D3-B Reference values are taken from PCBWorld’s published Table 22, while the D3-C Reference values are evaluated locally. These rows provide an existing-design reference for comparison with automatically produced routes. We use PCBWorld’s published board identifiers and split definitions to keep the comparison board-for-board.
paragraphs.zh: 我们沿用 PCBWorld-Bench [2] 的智能体对比设置。 每个实例是一块 KiCad [20] 原生 .kicad_pcb 格式的电路板，参考布线已被移除；元器件布局、网表和设计规则保持固定。 任务是完成该板上的连接，最终电路板由 KiCad 评估，而非由智能体自行判断是否成功。 我们使用与 PCBWorld 主对比相同的三套测试集：来自 D2-test 的 128 块合成双层无网格板；来自 D3-A 的 99 块小型开源板；以及来自 D3-B 的 10 块中型开源板。 我们还额外纳入 PCBWorld [2] 固定 D3-C 评测子集中的 10 块大型开源板。 PCBWorld 排除了 100 块 D3-A 板中的一块，因为其引擎接口无法加载它。 D3-B 和 D3-C 测试子集包含在各划分的焊盘数量范围内选取的双层板；D3-C 包含焊盘数超过 100 的电路板。 D2 测试来自合成分布的电路板上的布线，而三个 D3 划分均测试向真实设计（保留其原始设计规则设置）的迁移。 表 2–4 中的 Reference 行评估的是 PCBWorld 开源电路板语料库 [2] 中保留的原始已布线设计。 每个布线输入通过移除目标布线、同时保留元器件布局、网表和设计规则得到；Reference 是移除前的保留设计，使用相同的官方基于引擎的评估器打分。 D3-A 和 D3-B 的 Reference 数值取自 PCBWorld 公布的表 22，而 D3-C 的 Reference 数值由本地评估得到。 这些行为与自动生成的布线进行比较提供了现有设计的参考。 我们使用 PCBWorld 公布的电路板标识符和划分定义，以确保逐板对应地保持可比性。

paragraphs.en: We use PCBWorld’s KiCad-based board evaluator [ 2 ] for the reported routing quality. Published D2, D3-A, and D3-B baseline values in Tables 1 – 4 use PCBWorld’s single-rollout (@1) means from Table 22. PCBRouteAgent contributes one scored board per instance; any retries of unscored model-response failures are reported separately from this evaluation convention. Clean Pass (CP) is the primary success measure: a board passes only if all required connections are complete and KiCad reports zero error-level design-rule violations. We also report Potential Gain (Pot.), the change in the benchmark’s board-potential score from the unrouted state to the final board; Routability (Rout.), the fraction of required connections completed; and design-rule violation count (DRV), wirelength (WL), and via count. The main tables report routing quality. We additionally compare runtime, model calls, token usage, and API cost for our local PCBWorld and PCBRouteAgent runs under the same evaluation conditions with Claude Haiku 5.5. Both methods use the same timing scope; detailed efficiency results are provided in Appendix C . Potential incorporates connectivity, design-rule, wirelength, and via costs. These complementary metrics distinguish a complete and rule-clean board from partial connectivity or a route that is physically expensive.

paragraphs.en: On D2 (Table 1 ), both PCBRouteAgent variants achieve a clean-pass rate of 1.00 and routability of 1.000, matching the complete routing achieved by Freerouting and KiCadRoutingTools. The Opus variant obtains a potential gain of 16.27, compared with 15.84 for PCBWorld PPO and 14.42 for Freerouting. paragraphs.en: We presented PCBRouteAgent, a multimodal PCB routing agent that coordinates global planning and native geometric execution through structured feedback. Inspired by the interaction between board-level strategy and local routing decisions in engineering workflows, the framework combines routing guides, bounded local recovery, and targeted guide revisions. Evaluation on 247 synthetic and real-world boards shows that PCBRouteAgent achieves complete, rule-clean routing on D2 and D3-B and improves clean-pass rate over the best evaluated baseline on all three real-world subsets. Large-board completion and routing compactness remain important challenges. Future work will investigate more effective spatial and layer planning, adaptive recovery budgets, and routing refinement that reduces physical cost while preserving completed connections.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 PCBRouteAgent，这是一个多模态 PCB 布线智能体，通过结构化反馈协调全局规划与原生几何执行。 受工程工作流中板级策略与局部布线决策之间交互的启发，该框架结合了布线引导、有界局部恢复和针对性的引导修订。 在 247 个合成与真实电路板上的评估表明，PCBRouteAgent 在 D2 和 D3-B 上实现了完整且符合规则的布线，并在全部三个真实世界子集上将通过率（clean-pass rate）提升至超过所评估的最佳基线。 大型电路板的完成率和布线紧凑性仍是重要挑战。 未来的工作将研究更有效的空间与层规划、自适应恢复预算，以及在保持已完成连接的同时降低物理成本的布线精修。
